summary_en: Area Quest will acquire up to 746,000 shares (4.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 116.38 million yen via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on September 2, 2026, at 156 yen per share.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Area Quest announced on September 1, 2026, that its board of directors authorized an off-hours block purchase of up to 746,000 treasury shares for a maximum total of 116.38 million yen. The purchase will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading at 156 yen per share on September 2, 2026, at 8:45 AM, representing 4.8% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock). The company stated the purpose is to enhance shareholder returns through improved capital efficiency and to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The purchase is based on an existing authorization in the company's articles of incorporation under Article 165(2) of the Companies Act. Results will be disclosed after the trading session ends the same day. The number of shares to be purchased is fixed; however, the entire transaction may be partially or fully cancelled depending on market conditions.
